sourcedFrom: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. (UNDATED — nothing in the document states one)
cleanIntro:
The JAKL and JAKL 10 are Palmetto State Armory's piston-driven rifles. They break open like an AR — rear takedown pin, upper pivoting on the front pin — but the inside is different: a recoil spring assembly lives in the upper, and it has to come out before the bolt carrier group will.

PSA's family book covers four models. This guide follows only the JAKL and JAKL 10 procedure; the JAKL 9 and the Olcan have their own sections and are not mixed in.

Two lubrication rules carry through: the chamber is left dry, and the piston surface of the carrier gets no oil at all. PSA's book takes the carrier apart as far as the bolt and stops there.

steps.title: Selector on SAFE
steps.action: Muzzle in a safe direction, finger outside the trigger guard, and rotate the safety selector to SAFE before anything else.
steps.prose: Everything after this assumes the rifle cannot fire while you work the controls.
steps.quote: Place the safety selector on SAFE
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, printed p.20

steps.title: Magazine out — press and pull DOWN
steps.action: Hold the pistol grip with your finger off the trigger, press the magazine release button and pull the magazine straight down out of the well.
steps.prose: The magazine comes out before the charging handle moves; cycling with a loaded magazine in only feeds the next round.
steps.quote: Hold the grip of the firearm while keeping your finger off the trigger. Press the magazine release button and pull the magazine down to remove.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, printed p.20

steps.title: Charging handle back, lower bolt catch in, bolt locked open
steps.action: Unlock the charging handle and pull it all the way back, press in on the LOWER part of the bolt catch, then let the charging handle go. The bolt stays locked open on the catch. Any round in the chamber is pulled out on the way back.
steps.prose: Pressing the lower part locks the bolt; the upper part releases it.
steps.quote: Unlock and pull the charging handle all the way out [figure 3] and press in on the lower portion of the bolt catch [figure 4]. Release the charging handle. This locks the bolt in the open position.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, printed p.20

steps.title: LOOK into the chamber
steps.action: With the bolt held open, look through the ejection port into the chamber and confirm it is empty.
steps.prose: Seeing an empty chamber is the check. Working the action is not.
steps.quote: Look into the receiver through the ejection port and verify that there are no cartridges in the chamber [figure 5].
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, printed p.20

steps.title: Eye protection on
steps.action: Put on eye protection before the takedown pin moves. The recoil spring assembly comes out under spring pressure in a couple of steps.
steps.prose: PSA asks for eye protection every time the rifle is handled for cleaning.
steps.quote: Always wear eye protection every time before handling your firearm for cleaning and maintenance.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Rear takedown pin — push from the LEFT, pull until it stops
steps.action: Push in the takedown pin from the left side; it sits above and behind the safety lever. Then pull it from the right side until it stops. It is captive and will not come out of the receiver.
steps.prose: Stop when it stops. Do not lever it looking for a loose pin.
steps.quote: Push in the takedown pin, located above and to the rear of the safety lever on the left hand side of the receiver [figure 15].
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Upper pivots open on the front pin
steps.action: Hold the rear of the upper receiver and lift it, letting it pivot on the front pin. The lower's fire control group is now exposed. The front pin stays in.
steps.prose: Leave the fire control group alone — PSA publishes nothing for it.
steps.quote: Grasp the rear of the upper receiver and pull up, allowing it to pivot on the front pin. This will expose the fire control group.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly: push DOWN and FORWARD
steps.action: Push the recoil spring assembly down and toward the muzzle at the same time. It should come loose from the upper receiver.
steps.prose: Both directions at once is the trick. Keep control of it — it is under spring load.
steps.quote: Simultaneously push the recoil spring assembly down and towards the front of the firearm.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Lift the loosened recoil spring assembly out of the upper receiver. With it out, the bolt carrier group slides freely.
steps.prose: Until this part is out, the carrier will not come back.
steps.quote: You can then remove the recoil spring assembly from the upper receiver allowing the bolt carrier group to travel freely.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Charging handle back, tip the rifle back, carrier slides out
steps.action: Pull the charging handle back until it stops, then tip the rifle muzzle-up and backwards. The bolt carrier group slides out of the rear of the upper.
steps.prose: Catch the carrier as it comes out; do not let it drop onto the bench.
steps.quote: Then pull the charging handle until it stops and rotate the firearm backwards. This will extract the bolt carrier group.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — DISASSEMBLY, printed p.28

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the upper and lower, still joined at the front pin; the recoil spring assembly; and the bolt carrier group. PSA's cleaning section has you take the carrier apart for cleaning. That, and taking out the charging handle, is in DEEP CLEAN.
steps.prose: Nothing else comes off for routine cleaning.
steps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — MAINTENANCE, printed p.39

deepSteps.title: Charging handle to the large cutout
deepSteps.action: With the carrier out, move the charging handle back to the rear position where it lines up with the larger opening in the receiver (marked A in the book).
deepSteps.prose: It only comes out at that opening.
deepSteps.quote: With the bolt carrier group removed, move the charging handle to the rear position lining up with the larger opening marked (A).
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — REMOVING AND REVERSING THE CHARGING HANDLE, printed p.29

deepSteps.title: Slide the charging handle out sideways
deepSteps.action: With the handle lined up on the large cutout, slide it out of the receiver. It can go back in on either side. If the charging handle sled comes out too, put it back in its guide channels with its two holes facing the muzzle.
deepSteps.prose: The sled's orientation matters: holes to the front.
deepSteps.quote: Once the charging handle is lined up with this larger cutout you can slide it out
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — REMOVING AND REVERSING THE CHARGING HANDLE, printed p.29

deepSteps.title: Firing pin retaining pin out
deepSteps.action: Hook the loop of the firing pin retaining pin with a pick or another firing pin and pull it out of the carrier. The firing pin can then come out of the carrier.
deepSteps.prose: Work over the bench. The retaining pin is small.
deepSteps.quote: Remove firing pin retaining pin by using another firing pin pick to catch the loop of the retaining pin and pull it out.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — BOLT CARRIER GROUP DISASSEMBLY, printed p.32

deepSteps.title: Cam pin turned to the lower position, then out
deepSteps.action: With the firing pin out, turn the cam pin to the lower position in its slot and take it out. The bolt cannot leave the carrier until the cam pin is out.
deepSteps.prose: ⛔ The cam pin must go back in. PSA warns that without it the rifle can still fire and may explode.
deepSteps.quote: Once firing pin is removed, rotate the cam pin to the lower position in the cam pin slot and remove it in order to remove the bolt from the carrier.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — BOLT CARRIER GROUP DISASSEMBLY, printed p.32

deepSteps.title: Bolt out of the carrier
deepSteps.action: Slide the bolt assembly out of the carrier.
deepSteps.prose: Clean the bolt and the carrier as separate pieces from here.
deepSteps.quote: The bolt assembly may now be removed from the carrier assembly.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — BOLT CARRIER GROUP DISASSEMBLY, printed p.32

deepSteps.title: This is where PSA stops
deepSteps.action: The carrier group is apart: carrier, bolt, cam pin, firing pin and its retaining pin. PSA's book goes no further for routine maintenance — the extractor and the rest of the bolt stay as they are.
deepSteps.prose: Anything past this point is for a gunsmith.
deepSteps.quote: No further disassembly is required for routine maintenance.
deepSteps.cite: PSA JAKL FAMILY USER MANUAL — PSA JAKL USERS MANUAL JK-101756 (part code printed on the back cover, printed p.48). No date or revision is printed in the book. — BOLT CARRIER GROUP DISASSEMBLY, printed p.32

cleaning.name: CHAMBER
tasks: Chamber brush with bore solvent or CLP, several passes to scrub the inside of the chamber.
Wipe with clean patches until a patch stays clean.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Patch soaked in bore cleaner through the barrel several times, starting from the chamber end.
Cleaning brush through several times with more bore cleaner to lift copper fouling and powder residue.
Patch again; if it does not come out clean, brush again until a clean patch exits.
One patch with gun oil through the bore to protect it.
Outside of the barrel with a nylon brush and cleaner-lubricant, then wipe clean.
Do not let the cleaning rod scratch the inside of the barrel or chamber.

cleaning.name: BOLT CARRIER GROUP
tasks: Strip per the deep-clean steps and clean with CLP or a suitable solvent.
Wipe excess oil off the bolt assembly before reassembly.
⛔ Do not lubricate the inside of the carrier — lubricate the exterior only, a small amount spread evenly and the excess wiped off.
⛔ Never put lubricant on the piston surface — it builds carbon and can cause malfunctions.

cleaning.name: EXTERIOR AND GAS BLOCK
tasks: Wipe all metal with a clean cloth, then a lightly oiled cloth.
Oil the gas block's retainer plunger regularly so it moves freely.
Use only cleaning solutions made for firearms — some solvents can damage the finish.

reassembly: ⛔ Cam pin back in through its slot. Without it the rifle can still fire and may explode.
Firing pin in, then the firing pin retaining pin back through its loop hole.

If the charging handle sled came out, put it back in its guide channels with its two holes facing the muzzle. Line it up with the larger opening, insert the charging handle and push it in until it locks flush on the other side.
Bolt carrier group back into the upper receiver.
Recoil spring assembly back into the upper.
Close the upper onto the lower and push the rear takedown pin fully home from the right.
Function check before any live ammunition.
fncheck: PSA's book does not print a function check. With the rifle reassembled, magazine out and chamber seen empty: work the charging handle several times — the bolt should run without binding and close fully. Lock the bolt open on the lower part of the bolt catch and release it again. Make sure the takedown pin is pushed fully home. If anything binds or the bolt will not close, do not fire it; contact Palmetto State Armory.
